taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 270 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Scorpions is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
SHARED family: Krystilia (Wilderness, 65-100) plus Turael/Spria (15-30) and Mazchna (30-50) starter masters all assign scorpions.
Scorpions have very low defence and a 25% fire weakness; any melee weapon clears them instantly.
King scorpions (level 32) also count and have a 20% fire weakness.
Krystilia's task counts only Wilderness scorpion kills; bring risk-appropriate gear.
recommendedMethod: Scorpions have negligible defence, so any melee weapon (a Dragon scimitar or even cheaper) kills them in one or two hits; fire spells exploit their small fire weakness if training Magic. For Krystilia, kill Wilderness scorpions with risk-appropriate gear and an escape teleport; starter masters can be finished safely at the Al Kharid mine or Dwarven Mine.
